title: MJ-12 burned memo on Lancer

tellings.quote: so-called burned memo where uh Lancer and that was the code name for Kennedy was described

plain: Among the so-called Majestic documents, papers that describe a secret group of officials said to handle UFOs, there is said to be a partly burned memo that discusses "Lancer," the code name for John F. Kennedy, in 1963. The UFO historian Richard Dolan mentions it to Michels without naming a source, calling it the "so-called burned memo where Lancer, and that was the code name for Kennedy, was described." He brings it up because it would tie Kennedy's fate to the secret group that, by these papers' account, controlled the UFO question.
